business_model: Sell products through owned vending machines; the story also includes orders from others wanting machines retrofitted.
customer: College students buying Zen canisters, plus people who wanted a similar vending setup.

name: Vegan restaurant directory (HappyCow model)
one_liner: Map-based directory of vegan restaurants monetised by display ads and sponsored listings.
business_model: Display ads plus sponsored listings / higher placement
customer: Vegans and vegetarians searching for restaurants nearby; restaurants wanting visibility

name: Single-state hot springs directory (SoakOregon)
one_liner: Hyper-niche directory of Oregon hot springs monetised with display ads, with sister sites for other states.
business_model: Display advertising
customer: Travellers and outdoor enthusiasts looking for hot springs in Oregon

name: Rehab centre directory network (Sober Nation)
one_liner: Directory of rehab centres monetised through paid placements, run by Tim Stoddard.
business_model: Paid placements from rehab centres
customer: People seeking addiction treatment; rehab centres paying for leads/placement

name: SEO agency for rehab directories (Stodsey Internet Marketing)
one_liner: Agency built on directory SEO experience selling qualified addiction-treatment leads to rehab businesses.
business_model: Agency services / lead generation
customer: Addiction treatment providers

name: Care marketplace directory (Care.com)
one_liner: Large two-sided marketplace for finding childcare, senior care, pet care and care jobs; funnel captures emails.
business_model: Sponsored listings, memberships for hirers, no display ads
customer: Families seeking care; carers seeking jobs

name: MCP server and client directory (MCP.so)
one_liner: Directory of Model Context Protocol servers and clients, built within weeks of the MCP announcement, getting ~52k visits/month at three months old.
business_model: Possibly sponsored listings or display ads (not confirmed; may be pre-revenue)
customer: Developers and AI users looking for MCP servers and clients

name: SleepCalculator.com
one_liner: A free bedtime calculator that uses a desired wake-up time to suggest when to go to bed.
business_model: Free calculator monetized with display advertising.
customer: People who want to plan their bedtime around a chosen wake-up time.

name: SnowDayCalculator.com
one_liner: A seasonal website that predicts the chance of a school snow day based on a visitor's location and snow-day history.
business_model: Free seasonal calculator monetized with display advertising.
customer: Students, parents, and others interested in whether school will be closed because of snow.

name: Gematria calculator (gametrix.org)
one_liner: A free calculator that maps words and numbers to numerical values and finds words or phrases with matching values.
business_model: Free calculator monetized with display advertising.
customer: People interested in numerology, religious studies, conspiracy theories, or the numerical meaning of words.

name: Calculator.net
one_liner: A large free calculator website covering topics such as mortgages, auto loans, BMI, science, age, and GPA.
business_model: Free calculators monetized with display advertising.
customer: People looking for calculators for personal finance, health, education, science, and everyday calculations.

name: Add a niche calculator to an existing website
one_liner: Add a useful or entertaining calculator to an existing website as a way to extend its offer.
business_model: Not stated; suggested as an addition to an existing website.
customer: Existing website owners and their visitors; specific customer groups are not stated.
